basic_info.description: This is a truly unique opportunity to live on one of San Francisco's most beloved blocks! Situated at the southwest corner of Potomac overlooking Duboce Park, this three bedroom condo is ideally located in the heart of the city near many great shops and restaurants, public transit and parks. The flat has full southern exposure with verdant park views from nearly every room. Home is comprised of formal living room, two well sized bedroom, a smaller third bedroom, formal dining room and large eat in kitchen. The home is in original condition and preserves many beautiful period details, including decorative fireplaces, plaster mouldings, and handsome hardwood floors. Laundry on the porch off the hall on the porch. There is a full basement that could have garage potential (buyer to do their own due diligence regarding basement development). The upper two condos, 49 and 51 Potomac are also for sale individually or as a building. Buy one or all three!
